# Carbon Energy Nexus

> A free daily publication at carbonenergynexus.com on where carbon, energy, water and capital meet: CO2 capture and storage, carbon markets and removals, energy policy, produced water and the water footprint of energy, project finance and research. Each edition sorts news by electrons (power), molecules (fuels), pore space (the subsurface) and water, tracks projects on a seven step ladder from announcement to operation, and says what each story means for investors, regulators, industry and founders. Facts are sourced and dated; stages and outlooks are labeled as our judgment. General information, not investment advice.

## Tools
- [Energy and carbon footprint calculator](https://carbonenergynexus.com/calculator.html): households and companies, EPA and EIA factors, transparent Nexus Score
- [Frameworks](https://carbonenergynexus.com/frameworks.html): how projects, policy and carbon claims are judged

## Today's edition
- [COP31 ends without a deal, and its carbon capture and electrification goals fall with it](https://carbonenergynexus.com/): November 23, 2026. Two extra days in Antalya, but no cover decision. COP31 closed on Sunday after the EU and others rejected a text that named no fossil fuels, taking a draft 500 Mt a year capture goal and a 35% electrification target with it.
- [Capital: US Senate passes permitting bill 62 to 33; data centers would pay for grid upgrades](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#money)
- [Markets: AI selloff pauses as Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang; copper steadies](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#markets)
- [Regulation: Outside the failed text, electrification and geothermal move by voluntary pledge](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#world)
- [Water: Southwest hydropower ran 28% below average as Lake Powell neared turbine limits](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#water)
- [Projects: Dow's four reactor Texas nuclear plant holds a permit but not yet an FID](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#projects)
